businesses.name: Perry's Automotive
businesses.what_they_do: Independent auto repair shop on Main St in Spotswood, run by Frank Perry (named by a reviewer on the Google listing). Reviews describe general mechanical and tire work with an emphasis on honest, up-front communication. There is no website of its own; customers find it through Google Maps and word of mouth.
businesses.customers: Local Spotswood / Monroe-area car owners; repair-and-maintenance customers, repeat local trade.

size_signals.signal: Single-location shop at 116 Main St; directory lists Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, closed weekends
35 Google reviews accumulated over at least five years; owner named as Frank Perry in a review

website_review.trust_signals: 35 Google reviews (3.8 average) mentioning honest pricing and communication; no photos of work, licences or certifications published anywhere I could see
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Google Business Profile is unclaimed (the page shows a 'Claim this business' prompt) and has no website, no services list and no owner photos beyond Street View
website_review.search_basics: No site to rank. Even the Maps listing has no website link, so a 'auto repair Spotswood NJ' query surfaces directories rather than the shop itself
top_issues: Unclaimed Google Business Profile with no owner-controlled services or hours
No way to request a quote or book online; phone only

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: profile exists with address, hours and a 3.8 rating over 35 reviews, but it is unclaimed and carries no website, services or owner photos. Answerable: all that exists is a phone number and hours in Google - no web page states services, price ranges or turnaround, so an assistant has nothing to quote from. Bookable: phone-only, no form, no booking (I could not fetch robots.txt because there is no domain).

operations_signals.signal: Reviews praise 'great communication' and 'upfront information', implying staff time goes into phone status updates; no online status channel exists
One low-rated review complains about the owner's manner over a small gesture, suggesting a one-person front desk and reputation risk concentrated on the owner

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (services, hours, photos, quote link) so the shop shows up for local auto-repair searches
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps page shows 'Claim this business', plus 'Add website' and no services or owner photos

top_opportunities.opportunity: A one-page site with services, price ranges and a quote-request form
top_opportunities.evidence: No website exists; reviews show customers care about price transparency and communication

top_opportunities.opportunity: Missed-call text-back and automated appointment/ready-for-pickup reminders
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone-only intake with a small owner-run desk; communication is the thing reviewers single out

scores.reasons: Gap: nothing digital at all - unclaimed profile, no site, no booking. Pay: small independent shop with mid-size repair tickets, so budget is real but limited. Ease: claiming the profile and shipping a one-pager is days of work. Evidence: Google listing inspected directly; absence of a site is certain but there is little else to audit.

businesses.name: Waves of Motion Dance Center (formerly Dance Carousel)
businesses.what_they_do: Dance studio teaching ages 2 through adult, from Creative Movement and Combo classes up through technique levels and a competition company (Waves Dance Company). Runs a 2026-2027 class calendar with fall registration open, plus recitals, fundraisers and a Girl Scout program.
businesses.customers: Parents of young children and teens in Spotswood and nearby Middlesex County towns; also adult students and competition-team families.

size_signals.signal: Multiple instructors listed on a dedicated faculty page, and a separate competition-team track
Google profile identifies the studio as veteran-owned and women-owned, with a 5.0 rating
Registration runs through a DanceStudio-Pro online portal (account 6153), implying a roster large enough to justify studio software

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the view I could load

website_review.primary_cta: 'REGISTER HERE' (links out to the DanceStudio-Pro portal) and '2026-2027 Class Calendar'
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Registration portal at dancestudio-pro.com; no Booksy/Fresha/Vagaro, no online trial-class booking calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Competition team page, award badges (rendered as images), current 2026-2027 season calendar, social links, veteran/women-owned attributes on Google
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer reads 2025-2026 (that is the current season, so not stale); the Classes page body text is only 'Class offerings are subject to change' with every class description drawn as a flat image; navigation still carries auto-generated page names like 'copy-of-dress-code' and 'general-8'
website_review.search_basics: Home title and meta description name dance and Spotswood, and a LocalBusiness JSON-LD block is present with the right address. But class/level content, tuition and schedule exist only as images or calendar widgets, so there is almost no crawlable service text
top_issues: Class descriptions and any tuition detail are images of text - invisible to search and to AI assistants
Phone number is plain text with no tel: link, so no click-to-call on the phone layout
Registration requires leaving the site and there is no schedule or price in text form

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile has hours (closed now, opens 4:30 PM Mon), category, website, photos and ownership attributes; robots.txt allows all crawlers with only tracking-parameter and PetalBot exclusions, so AI bots are not blocked. Answerable: the homepage's real text is essentially the address and phone, the class page is four images of text, and no tuition figure appears anywhere - a crawler cannot answer 'what class suits a 6-year-old and what does it cost'. Bookable: genuine online registration through DanceStudio-Pro, but the studio site only links out, publishes no schedule text, and the contact form inputs have no programmatic labels.

operations_signals.signal: Office hours are only Mon-Thu 4:30-7:30pm, so parent questions outside that window go unanswered while the site pushes registration 24/7
Three separate calendars (class, studio, monthly) that parents must check manually - reminder and change communications look manual
A CAREERS page is maintained, indicating ongoing hiring of instructors/office help

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn the image-only class descriptions into real text pages per program/level with ages, schedule and tuition so parents and their AI assistants can get answers
top_opportunities.evidence: Classes page shows only 'Class offerings are subject to change' plus four images containing the descriptions

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated parent Q&A and registration follow-up (email/SMS) covering placement, dress code, tuition and recital dates
top_opportunities.evidence: Office hours are limited to 4:30-7:30pm Mon-Thu while registration is promoted around the clock

top_opportunities.opportunity: Click-to-call plus a sticky Register/Free-Trial button on the phone layout
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: link anywhere on the page, and the mobile hero CTA sits below a full-width photo

scores.reasons: Gap: real - all service and price detail is trapped in images, even though registration itself works. Pay: established studio with faculty, a competition team and seasonal tuition revenue. Ease: text pages plus an answering bot over existing class data is a short engagement. Evidence: site, robots.txt, JSON-LD and Google profile all inspected directly.

businesses.name: Tune Town Music Academy
businesses.what_they_do: Music school offering private piano lessons, vocal lessons and audition preparation for children, in acoustically treated studios with a music-production room. Leads with a free trial lesson and runs a small blog on music education.
businesses.customers: Parents of children roughly ages 5-18 in Spotswood and neighbouring Middlesex County towns.

size_signals.signal: Site claims 12+ years in Spotswood and 300+ students
Google Business Profile at 1 American Way Ste D, opening 10 AM, local (732) phone
Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp contact channels linked from the site

listing.rating: none shown - no rating or review count displayed

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book Free Trial Lesson' / 'Register for Free Trial' form, plus click-to-call
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Free-trial request form on the homepage; the enrollment page requires a password, so no self-serve signup and no visible calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Named parent testimonials, student and completion stats, studio photos, FAQ block, structured data for courses
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Nothing visibly stale, but every blog post carries the same lastmod date (2026-11-13) and the testimonials read like template copy - inference: the site looks recently rebuilt or template-populated, so the '12+ years / 300+ students' figures may not reflect a long-established local business
website_review.search_basics: Title and description both name piano/vocal lessons and Spotswood, and JSON-LD (MusicSchool, Course list, FAQ) matches the page. Gaps: no street address or opening hours in page text or schema, no pricing, and piano/vocal/audition have no separate URLs - the sitemap lists only home, blog and thank-you pages
top_issues: Site phone (929) 543-7229 does not match the Google listing (732) 490-1712, and the street address is missing from the site and schema
No tuition or price range anywhere; enrollment page is password-gated
No Google reviews yet, which weakens the free-trial pitch for parents comparing studios

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile exists with address, hours, category and site link but shows no rating or reviews; robots.txt explicitly allows OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and Googlebot. Answerable: the homepage states programs, ages, lesson lengths and an FAQ in real text, with matching MusicSchool/Course/FAQ JSON-LD - but omits street address, hours and any price. Bookable: the free-trial form has properly labelled fields and a real button; enrollment needs a password from the studio, so an agent can request a trial but cannot complete signup.

operations_signals.signal: Enrollment is gated by a password staff must hand over, guaranteeing a manual back-and-forth for every new student
Trial requests arrive as a plain form (name, age, phone) so staff must manually match teacher and time slot
A single mobile number is used for calls, form callbacks and WhatsApp, implying a very small admin team

top_opportunities.opportunity: Self-serve trial booking with real available slots, replacing the request form plus password-gated enrollment
top_opportunities.evidence: Homepage form only collects name/age; /enrollment asks 'Please enter the enrollment password to continue'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix name/address/phone consistency and build reviews: use the Google number and address on the site, add them to schema, and automate review requests after recitals
top_opportunities.evidence: Google shows (732) 490-1712 at 1 American Way Ste D while the site shows (929) 543-7229 and no street address; Google shows no reviews

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish tuition and term dates as text so a parent's AI assistant can answer cost questions
top_opportunities.evidence: No prices on the homepage, FAQ or schema; the Offer entries in JSON-LD carry no price

scores.reasons: Gap: technically the strongest site in the batch (schema, FAQ, AI-bot-friendly robots), so what is missing is pricing, consistent NAP and self-serve scheduling. Pay: small tuition-based school, one location. Ease: pricing pages and NAP fixes are quick; trial scheduling needs a booking tool. Evidence: site and profile fully accessible, but no reviews and unverifiable size claims.

businesses.name: CellTech Repairs Spotswood
businesses.what_they_do: Former phone, laptop and computer repair shop at 482 Main St, Spotswood, known for iPhone screen and battery work and laptop repairs. Google now marks the location 'Permanently closed', so there is no current trading activity to research.
businesses.customers: Formerly local consumers with phone, tablet and laptop repairs.

size_signals.signal: 240 Google reviews at 4.5 average, accumulated over several years before closing - a substantial former customer base

website_review.out_of_date_signs: Google listing states 'Permanently closed' and posting is turned off

agent_readiness.notes: Permanently closed per Google Maps; no further readiness assessment needed. The 240 legacy reviews are the kind of asset that would have been worth preserving at a neighbouring shop, but there is nothing to work with here.

operations_signals.signal: Listing marked permanently closed with posting turned off; a 2-year-old review already complains about a GPU repair that was never resolved

scores.reasons: Closed: confirmed 'Permanently closed' on Google Maps, so scores are near floor by definition. Evidence is high only because the closure is unambiguous.

businesses.name: Colorful Creations Photography
businesses.what_they_do: Photography studio shooting family portraits, seniors, birthdays and cake smashes, headshots, prom, couples/engagement and holiday mini sessions, in-studio or on location, plus traditional and 360 photo booth rentals for events. The site says the team is professionally trained with photography degrees.
businesses.customers: Local families and high-school seniors in Spotswood and surrounding Middlesex County towns; event hosts and small businesses buying photo booth packages.

size_signals.signal: About page refers to a team of photographers each holding a photography degree
Squarespace storefront with a cart/gift-certificate flow and a separate photo booth line
Google profile shows a 5.0 rating in the Maps view, category Photography studio

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the view I could load

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book' in the nav, which opens the Acuity scheduling block
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Real self-serve booking - Acuity Scheduling embed on /book with date/time slots; gift certificates purchasable at the bottom of the appointment list
website_review.trust_signals: Gallery pages, a detailed about page, Instagram feed embedded on the homepage, FAQ section, 5.0 Google rating
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The homepage above the fold is a black screen with only 'Welcome to Colorful Creations Photography!' - no photo, service description, town or call to action; no meta description on any page I checked; phone number absent from the site and from Google
website_review.search_basics: Page title is just 'Colorful Creations Photography' with no service or town, meta description is empty, and the only JSON-LD is a WebSite block - no LocalBusiness, no pricing, no town text on the homepage. Services appear only as prose inside the About page
top_issues: Homepage says nothing about services, location or price above the fold - on mobile it is a black screen with a headline
No LocalBusiness schema, no meta descriptions, no town or service in titles, so searches like 'family photographer Spotswood' are unlikely to land
No published session pricing/packages and no phone number; Google profile has no hours or phone either

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: a Google profile exists with the right address, category and site link, but Google shows no hours and no phone ('Add missing information' prompts) and I could not see a review count. Answerable: the only structured data is WebSite, meta descriptions are empty, and neither price nor town appears on the homepage; service text lives in About-page prose, so an assistant cannot answer 'how much is a mini session in Spotswood'. Bookable: strong - Acuity Scheduling is embedded with real slots, and the contact form has proper labels, so an agent can book without a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: Holiday demand is managed by posting 'new dates opened' and 'limited spots left' messages on Instagram, which then appear as the homepage content - manual, batch-driven marketing
Email-only contact address; no phone on the site or Google, so every enquiry is an inbox item that someone must triage
FAQ covers delivery timelines, number of photos, prints and paying the balance after deposit - routine questions that recur per booking

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the homepage above the fold with real headline, service list, Spotswood location, package starting prices and a Book button, plus LocalBusiness JSON-LD and meta descriptions
top_opportunities.evidence: Mobile and desktop homepage show only 'Welcome to Colorful Creations Photography!' with no service, town, price or CTA; meta description empty; schema is WebSite only

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish session packages and price ranges as text pages (family, senior, cake smash, mini sessions, photo booth) so assistants can quote
top_opportunities.evidence: No prices anywhere on site; FAQ mentions deposits and balances but no amounts

top_opportunities.opportunity: Complete the Google profile (phone, hours, services, photos) and add automated enquiry replies and review requests after each shoot
top_opportunities.evidence: Google shows 'Add place's phone number' and 'Add hours' prompts; contact is email-only

scores.reasons: Gap: booking is genuinely good but discovery and content are poor - blank-looking homepage, no schema, no pricing, no phone. Pay: small studio selling modest per-session tickets, so a modest budget. Ease: a one-person consultancy can fix the homepage, schema and pricing pages in days. Evidence: site, booking embed, forms and Google profile all inspected.

businesses.name: Spotswood Funeral Home
businesses.what_they_do: Full-service funeral home and cremation provider on Main St, with burial and cremation arrangements, pre-arrangements (pre-need) planning, obituary hosting, aftercare and an online flower ordering link. The site also covers 'when death occurs' and making-arrangements guidance for families.
businesses.customers: Grieving families in Spotswood, Helmetta and surrounding Middlesex County towns; also adults pre-planning their own arrangements.

size_signals.signal: Site lists a manager, Theodore J. Ricci, plus facilities and staff pages
16 Google reviews at 4.4 with owner responses to critical reviews
Full obituary listing service with individual obituary pages, implying steady case volume

website_review.primary_cta: Phone (732) 251-2440 and a pre-arrangements form, per the indexed pages
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Pre-arrangements enquiry form and contact form; no online arrangement scheduling or price calculator
website_review.trust_signals: Owner replies on Google reviews, facility photos by owner, extensive guidance pages, named staff and manager
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Could not assess - my access was blocked; the site runs on a funeral-home website platform (tribute-cloud)
website_review.search_basics: Separate pages exist for services, making arrangements, pre-arrangements, FAQ, when death occurs, obituaries and contact, which is a solid structure; but no published price ranges were visible in the pages I could see indirectly
top_issues: Website blocks non-browser clients: every fetch (homepage, /our-services, /pre-arrangements) returned Cloudflare 403 from my IP, so I could not review layout, schema or forms
No price or package ranges published, which is exactly what a cost-sensitive family (or their assistant) searches for first
Google shows 'Open 24 hours' but the site offers no after-hours digital intake beyond a form

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile is complete-ish (address, 24-hour listing, category, website, phone, owner photos) and the site has a clean page-per-topic structure. Answerable: coaching low only because I could not read the live page - search-indexed content shows no price ranges, and the site refused programmatic requests (Cloudflare 403), which is a real risk for AI crawlers and anyone's assistant even though Googlebot is usually allowlisted. Bookable: pre-arrangements and contact forms exist, but real arrangements still run through a phone call or in-person meeting, which is normal for the trade yet leaves after-hours demand unanswered.

operations_signals.signal: A critical Google review alleges cost pressure at a vulnerable moment; the owner replied publicly, showing reputation handling sits with management
Listing advertises 24-hour availability, so first calls arrive at all hours and must be triaged by staff
Pre-arrangement requests are collected through a web form that staff must follow up by phone

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish clear package and price ranges (direct cremation, viewing plus service, graveside) as real text pages
top_opportunities.evidence: Search-indexed pricing content not found; the main cost complaint in reviews centres on price handling

top_opportunities.opportunity: 24/7 first-call triage agent that answers after hours, captures the essentials and alerts the on-call director
top_opportunities.evidence: Google lists the home as open 24 hours, but intake is a form or a phone call

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix site accessibility to crawlers/assistants (allow AI search bots through Cloudflare, confirm robots.txt) so the FAQ and service pages can be quoted
top_opportunities.evidence: Homepage, /our-services and /pre-arrangements all returned HTTP 403 to my fetches

scores.reasons: Gap: moderate - the site is well-structured but opaque on price and inaccessible to automated clients. Pay: high-ticket, essential service with steady local demand. Ease: content and access fixes are quick, but anything touching intake needs care in a grief context. Evidence: weakest in the batch because the site blocked every fetch and I had to rely on Google and indexed summaries.

businesses.name: Tameless Designs
businesses.website: https://www.tamelessdesigns.com/ (www only; apex https://tamelessdesigns.com fails with an SSL cipher error)
businesses.what_they_do: Custom apparel and decoration shop - directories list screen printing, direct-to-garment printing, embroidery, graphic design and custom shirts - that also sells its own gear line aimed at tradespeople and first responders. The live site is a ClickFunnels-hosted brand page with a 'Shop The Standard' section, testimonials and a contact form rather than a quote or order flow.
businesses.customers: Local teams, clubs and small businesses ordering decorated shirts, plus individual buyers of its own trades/first-responder apparel brand.

size_signals.signal: Google profile lists 4.5 rating, category Screen printer, opens 9 AM, phone and website
Works from an 84 Adirondack Ave address; a directory notes appointment-only contact
Site runs blog content on contractor lead management and social-media tooling, suggesting an owner-operated business stretching into marketing advice

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the view I could load

website_review.primary_cta: Contact form capture ('submit your info and we'll reach out'); no quote builder or shop checkout verified
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Lead-capture form only - no quantities, garment choices, artwork upload, price estimate or online ordering
website_review.trust_signals: Testimonials and a brand story on the funnel page; 4.5 Google rating
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Apex https://tamelessdesigns.com fails in Chrome with ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH (broken certificate); the working www address redirects to a ClickFunnels page (myclickfunnels.com) that returned Cloudflare 403 to me
website_review.search_basics: Title positions the site as 'Gear & Mindset for Builders, Protectors...' rather than screen printing in Spotswood, so the domain does not read as a local print shop to search or to an assistant; no pricing
top_issues: Broken TLS on the bare domain, so anyone typing tamelessdesigns.com without www gets a security error in Chrome
No quote/order path: no quantity, garment, artwork upload or pricing - just a contact form
Site is a ClickFunnels funnel whose page title targets a lifestyle brand, not 'screen printing Spotswood NJ'

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile exists with address, category, hours and website, but the site's own addressing is shaky (apex TLS failure) and Cloudflare blocked both my browser and fetcher, so I could not check robots.txt or schema at all. Answerable: no prices, no turnaround times and no product/decorated-method detail in readable text that I could verify; the indexed page emphasises brand story. Bookable: nothing bookable - the only conversion path is a contact-me form, and a print job needs quantities, garment choice and artwork, none of which the form appears to collect.

operations_signals.signal: Inbound work depends on a generic contact form plus phone, with appointment-only visits per a directory - every quote is a manual reply
Owner publishes marketing/lead-management advice for contractors, so they already think about lead capture - the shop's own funnel has no qualification step

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the contact form with a real quote request (quantity, garment, colours, deadline, artwork upload) that returns an estimate range instantly
top_opportunities.evidence: Site only asks visitors to submit contact information; no pricing or order flow found

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix hosting and TLS: valid certificate on the apex domain, and a site whose title/URL says screen printing in Spotswood
top_opportunities.evidence: https://tamelessdesigns.com fails with ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH and www redirects to a Cloudflare-protected ClickFunnels page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Complete and claim the Google profile with service list, photos of finished jobs and a quote link so local searches land somewhere useful
top_opportunities.evidence: Google profile shows a category, phone and site but no review count, service list or job photos in the view available

scores.reasons: Gap: largest in the batch - broken TLS, no quote flow, brand-first site for a local print shop. Pay: small owner-operated shop with modest order values, so budget is tight. Ease: recovery work is straightforward but the site has to be migrated off a Cloudflare-blocked funnel host. Evidence: weakest of the open businesses because every attempt to load the site was blocked, so most findings come from Google and indexed snippets.

caveats: Google Maps place pages rendered in a limited view for part of the session: ratings were visible but review counts were shown for only some businesses (Perry's 35, CellTech 240, Spotswood Funeral Home 16).
Inference flags are marked inline (Tune Town site recency/size claims; Waves of Motion season footer).
Two sites (spotswoodfh.com and tamelessdesigns.com) returned Cloudflare 403 to every fetch from this machine, so those reviews rest partly on search-indexed page text rather than a live read.
data_gaps: Google web search results triggered a CAPTCHA wall; listing data was taken from Google Maps place pages instead.
Waves of Motion, Colorful Creations and Tameless Designs review counts were not displayed in the Maps views available, and Tune Town showed no rating or reviews at all.

spotswoodfh.com and tamelessdesigns.com returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to both browser and fetcher, so robots.txt, JSON-LD, mobile layout and form behaviour could not be inspected; Spotswood Funeral Home's phone-layout assessment is therefore 'unknown'.
Tameless Designs' apex domain fails TLS (ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH) and its www host is a Cloudflare-protected ClickFunnels page, so no live page or robots.txt was readable.
CellTech Repairs is permanently closed, so no further research was done.
